## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Note any checks not run, and distinguish fake-agent tests from real-agent verification.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing contracts, or explains a deliberate compatibility change.
- [ ] Relevant failure paths and regression coverage are addressed.
- [ ] Tests and installer checks pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Affected CLI help, documentation, and skills are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, private agent transcripts, or generated state are included.
